Who We Are

Engineering the intelligence behind tomorrow.

Astrixcore Semiconductors is a semiconductor technology company. We architect computing platforms, deterministic processing, embedded intelligence and precision control as complete silicon systems, engineered so that behaviour is defined in hardware and results are predictable.

Our focus is architectural clarity, fault awareness and verification-driven design. Every system we define is built for engineers who need control that responds exactly as specified.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Straight answers about Astrixcore and AX-DetermMCU.

What is Astrixcore Semiconductors?

Astrixcore Semiconductors is a semiconductor technology company based in Chennai, India. Its focus areas are intelligent computing architectures, deterministic control technologies, safety-oriented silicon and semiconductor engineering.

What is AX-DetermMCU?

AX-DetermMCU is Astrixcore's deterministic, safety-oriented microcontroller architecture for precision industrial control. It combines a time-triggered event matrix, dual-core lockstep execution, ECC-protected memory, hardware safety mechanisms, precision PWM and industrial control interfaces.

What is a time-triggered event matrix?

It is a scheduling architecture that releases control events against a fixed timebase, so system timing is predictable and repeatable.

What does dual-core lockstep mean?

Two processor cores execute the same instructions in synchrony while a comparator checks their results. A fault in either core is exposed at hardware level.

What does ECC-protected memory do?

Error-correcting codes detect and correct bit-level faults in stored data, protecting memory contents.

Is AX-DetermMCU available as silicon?

AX-DetermMCU is currently an architecture specification. Silicon is not manufactured or commercially available at this time. Technical discussions are welcome through the contact form.

How can I contact Astrixcore?

Use the contact form on this page or write to astrixcoresemiconductors@gmail.com. Astrixcore is based in Chennai, India.
